source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: As we begin franchising, we want to integrate additional locations while still giving each of them full control. I want https://shatterhouse.example built from scratch, but using the same kind of template. One of our competitors has the layout we really like: it is simple, lists every location, and is easy to navigate.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I agree with that plan. My main concern is that once we rebrand, upgrade, and change the website, the SEO for Harbor Valley Shatter House may suffer. What can we do to minimize that damage?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: It's really one type of website that stays the same throughout all the websites—we copy and paste it and just change the branding and wording. All packages and prices stay the same.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey! I wanted to send over the vision for the website.

The goal is to build a national brand website for SHATTER HOUSE that can support multiple locations and future franchise growth.

Main Website:
https://shatterhouseusa.example

For the visual direction, use a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design with simplicity similar to RageWorks USA. The branding should combine black, purple, and white with large images, generous spacing, and easy navigation.

Homepage Sections:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage should immediately show visitors what we offer and allow them to select their location.

Current Locations:

Linden Falls
Port Averly
Ridgehaven

Give every location its own dedicated page while keeping the design and branding consistent across all locations. The website should be built so future locations can be added easily without redesigning the site.

Future examples:

Mesa Crest
Highpoint
Riverbend
Franchise Locations

The overall feel should be a national entertainment brand, not a local business website.

value_updates.brand_presentation_scale: national entertainment brand rather than a local-business website

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I like the website, but I need it more like https://shatterhousefranchise.example/ and https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example.

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that the previewed website does not sufficiently match the desired visual style and requests closer resemblance to the cited Shatter House websites.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: The latest requested change is not clear to me. As discussed, the new first website will be designed using your competitor website’s layout; for the second website, I will reuse the mockup’s structure only if you like the mockup.
